votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 50 of 2025, Amending the Administrative Hearing Process.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts an ordinance amending the Salt Lake City Code to update the general administrative hearing process for civil violations, replacing the Small Claims Court appeal process with a consistent administrative appeal process and adding a fee for formal administrative appeals.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 51 of 2025, Design Review Standards Amendment.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance amending Chapter 21A.59 of the Salt Lake City Code relating to Design Review, clarifying applicability, improving code language clarity, removing duplicative standards, and introducing new design standards.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 16 of 2025, adopting the Capital Improvement Program Project-Specific Allocations for Fiscal Year 2025-26 as shown on the attached Exhibit A Funding Log, with legislative intent to address 1200 East median funding needs and to examine traffic calming CIP allocations on hold due to S.B. 195 for potential reallocation to school safety projects.
votes.description: Adopts the FY2025-26 Capital Improvement Program project-specific funding allocations and expresses legislative intent to address 1200 East median curb/gutter/irrigation needs and to recapture and reallocate traffic calming funds held due to state legislation toward school safety projects.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 22 of 2025, approving Holladay's admission as an additional member of the Central Wasatch Commission.
votes.description: Adopts a resolution admitting the City of Holladay as a member of the Central Wasatch Commission, which implements the Mountain Accord and oversees environmental, recreational, transportation, and economic values of the Central Wasatch Mountains.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 23 of 2025 for the Salt Lake City Housing Program Funds and adopt a Legislative Intent that the Administration provide preliminary metrics on these programs to the Council halfway through fiscal year 2026 and at annual intervals thereafter.
votes.description: Adopts updated policies for Salt Lake City's Housing Program Funding, establishes a new Housing Programs Loan Committee and a Tenant and Homeowner Loan Fund, and directs the Administration to report preliminary program metrics to the Council mid-FY2026 and annually thereafter.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 24 of 2025, Legislative Policy and Budgetary Guidelines for the Home Repair Program.
votes.description: Adopts a resolution updating the legislative policy and budgetary guidelines governing Salt Lake City's Home Repair Program.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 25 of 2025, Legislative Policy for the Community Land Trust Program.
votes.description: Adopts a resolution updating the legislative policy for Salt Lake City's Community Land Trust Program, which supports affordable homeownership opportunities.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 26 of 2025, Legislative Policy for the NOAH Preservation Program.
votes.description: Adopts a resolution updating the legislative policy for Salt Lake City's Naturally Occurring Affordable Housing (NOAH) Preservation Program, which works to preserve existing affordable housing stock.
Approves all consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for several zoning and land use matters and approving the appointment of Charlotte Dubiel to the Library Board.
